messages:
marta (People Ops): Quick update on the review push  please note a small process change for attachments and emergency extensions.

marta (People Ops): Deadlines: all review forms due FRI 11:59pm PT. Calibration panels Mon/Tue next week. If you need an extension (medical, travel, parental), submit the short form by Thu noon: https://forms.redwood/extension

len (People Ops): New doc rule: attachments >3MB must be uploaded to Drive and linked in the form (put link in manager_summary). This avoids import timeouts.

alex (Eng Manager): For folks on part-time schedule, should we prorate ratings or mark limited data?

marta (People Ops): @alex mark as "partial-cycle" with hire/leave dates + percent FTE in manager_summary. We'll handle prorating in calibration.

tay (IC): If a manager accidentally submits and needs to update manager_summary, can they retract?

len (People Ops): Retractions: you can edit until the deadline. After deadline, only People Ops can unlock (send a request here with reason).

kira (Finance): Heads up  if leveling adjustments are proposed, include cost-center tag in the form (format: CC-1234). Finance will read that column for budget impacts.

marta (People Ops): Small template for manager_summary to copy/paste:
```
Role + context
Top 2 contributions (1-2 lines each)
Suggested rating (word + number)
Development areas (1 line)
Cost center tag: CC-XXXX
```

len (People Ops): Import note: CSV header must be exactly: employee_email, manager_summary, cost_center. Case-sensitive.

alex (Eng Manager): Can we reserve group calibration for obvious cases (meets + no flags)? Saves time for deep cases.

marta (People Ops): Yes  tag rows "quick-pass" in the sheet. Calibrators will batch them into 10m quick reviews. Keep one example doc per batch.

tay (IC): Timeline question: when do ICs see final manager comments?

len (People Ops): IC visibility: managers choose "share after calibration" (default) or "share now" if they want earlier transparency. Note: outcomes may change after calibration.

review-bot: Reminder: Review form deadline in ~72 hours. Link: https://app.redwood/reviews

marta (People Ops): Thanks all  well post a short validator tool and a 1-page calibration cheat sheet later today in #review-ops. Ping @len or me if import fails. :white_check_mark:
